title:
[Bug]: offsetText is colored based on tick.color instead of tick.labelcolor
### Bug summary

In vers

observations: Bug title: offsetText is colored based on tick.color instead of tick.labelcolor
Bug summary: setting ytick.labelcolor / xtick.labelcolor in styles/rcParams does not change color of exponent label (offsetText); exponent label uses xtick.color/ytick.color instead
Reproduction code provided: uses plt.rcParams.update({'ytick.labelcolor': 'red'}) and plots large numbers (1.01e9, etc.) to trigger offsetText (exponent) display
Images referenced: 'wrong_color' and 'correct_color' show visual difference (exponent label color mismatch vs expected)
Patch provided: modifies axis.py lines 2203 and 2456 to conditionally use xtick.labelcolor/ytick.labelcolor unless it's 'inherit' (default), then fall back to tick.color
Affected components: axis.XAxis and axis.YAxis offset_text initialization (likely in matplotlib.axis)
Referenced files/lines: axis.py lines ~2203 and ~2456 (in _init_offset_text method for XAxis and YAxis)
Error type: configuration/rcParams not applied correctly to offsetText color
c1_text.causal_hypothesis: The offsetText (exponent label) color is hardcoded to use tick.color rcParam instead of checking tick.labelcolor rcParam, except when tick.labelcolor is explicitly set to a non-inherit value.
